_meta.name: Targum
_meta.description: Vocabulary from the Aramaic translations of the Hebrew Bible
_meta.note: Scholarly Tier 2 - Essential for understanding Aramaic Bible translations

מימרא.fullDefinition: The 'Word' of God - Targumic circumlocution to avoid anthropomorphism. Where Hebrew says 'God spoke,' Targum says 'the Memra of the LORD.'
מימרא.theological_note: Intermediary concept significant for understanding Logos theology
מימרא.examples: מימרא דיי - the Word of the LORD

שכינתא.fullDefinition: God's dwelling presence - Targumic term for God's manifest presence. Avoids direct identification of God with a place.
שכינתא.theological_note: Replaces direct statements about God dwelling in a place
שכינתא.examples: שכינת יי - the Presence of the LORD

יקרא.fullDefinition: The Glory of God - Targumic term replacing Hebrew כָּבוֹד when applied to God
יקרא.theological_note: Renders Hebrew kavod; used to express divine manifestation
יקרא.examples: יקרא דיי - the Glory of the LORD

קדם.fullDefinition: Before, in front of - Targumic circumlocution. 'Before the LORD' avoids saying God was at a place.

מן קדם.definition: from before, from the presence of
מן קדם.fullDefinition: From before - Targumic circumlocution for divine actions. 'From before the LORD' = the LORD did something.
מן קדם.examples: מן קדם יי - from before the LORD

אלהא.fullDefinition: God (with definite article). Aramaic equivalent of Hebrew אֱלֹהִים
אלהא.examples: אלהא דישראל - the God of Israel

יי.fullDefinition: Targumic representation of the Tetragrammaton (YHWH). Read as Adonai.
יי.note: Sometimes written as ה׳ or יהוה

רבונא.fullDefinition: Master, Lord (often of God). רבון עלמא = Master of the World
רבונא.examples: רבון עלמיא - Master of the Worlds

פולחנא.fullDefinition: Worship, divine service. From פלח 'to serve'

טעותא.fullDefinition: Error, idolatry. Targumic term for pagan worship/idols

קרבנא.fullDefinition: Offering, sacrifice brought near to God

עלתא.fullDefinition: Burnt offering (entirely consumed). Aramaic for Hebrew עֹלָה

חטאתא.fullDefinition: Sin offering. Aramaic for Hebrew חַטָּאת

אשמתא.fullDefinition: Guilt offering. Aramaic for Hebrew אָשָׁם

כפרתא.fullDefinition: Atonement/mercy seat. Aramaic for Hebrew כַּפֹּרֶת

מקדשא.fullDefinition: Sanctuary, Temple. Aramaic for Hebrew מִקְדָּשׁ

לויא.fullDefinition: Levite. Member of the tribe of Levi

נביאה.examples: נבואת נביאיא - prophecy of the prophets

רוח קודשא.fullDefinition: The Holy Spirit - divine spirit of prophecy
רוח קודשא.examples: רוח נבואה מן קדם יי - spirit of prophecy from before the LORD

מלאכא.fullDefinition: Angel, messenger. Aramaic for Hebrew מַלְאָךְ
מלאכא.examples: מלאכא דיי - angel of the LORD

אורייתא.fullDefinition: The Torah, the Law. Aramaic for Hebrew תּוֹרָה
אורייתא.examples: אורייתא דמשה - the Torah of Moses

פתגמא.fullDefinition: Word, saying, commandment. Renders Hebrew דָּבָר in many contexts
פתגמא.examples: פתגמיא דאורייתא - words of the Torah

פיקודא.fullDefinition: Commandment, precept. Aramaic for Hebrew פִּקּוּדִים
פיקודא.examples: פיקודי יי - commandments of the LORD

קימא.examples: קימא דיי - covenant of the LORD

פריק.examples: פרק ית עמיה - he redeemed his people

גאל.fullDefinition: To redeem (as kinsman-redeemer). Cognate of Hebrew גָּאַל

משיחא.fullDefinition: The Messiah, the anointed one. Aramaic for Hebrew מָשִׁיחַ

עלמא.fullDefinition: World, age, eternity. עלמא דין = this world; עלמא דאתי = the world to come
עלמא.examples: עלמא דאתי - the world to come

עלמא דאתי.fullDefinition: The world to come, the future age, eschatological time

גיהנם.fullDefinition: Gehenna (place of punishment). From גֵּי הִנֹּם (Valley of Hinnom)

גן עדן.fullDefinition: Garden of Eden, Paradise. Place of reward for the righteous

זכו.fullDefinition: Merit, virtue, good deeds. Important Targumic concept
זכו.examples: זכות אבהן - merit of the fathers

חובא.fullDefinition: Sin, guilt, debt. Opposite of זְכוּ
חובא.examples: חובי עמא - sins of the people

תשובתא.fullDefinition: Repentance, return (to God). From תוב 'to return'

רחמין.examples: מן קדם יי רחמין - from before the merciful LORD

דינא.fullDefinition: Judgment, law, court case. Used for divine judgment
דינא.examples: יום דינא רבא - the great day of judgment

תקיף.fullDefinition: Strong, mighty. Often applied to God

גבר.fullDefinition: Man, warrior, hero. Aramaic for Hebrew גֶּבֶר

אינש.fullDefinition: Man, person, human being. Used for generic 'person' or indefinite 'someone'
אינש.examples: בר אינש - son of man (human being)

בר נש.fullDefinition: Son of man = human being. Messianic title in Daniel 7:13
